$comment: Curated Ask the HQ question pills (EN and ID). topic: work, ai, career, contact or perspectives (the five topic pills; the first four of a topic show when it expands). tags: ASK_TAGS values (src/ask/protocol.ts) used to match follow-ups to an answer. followUps: ids shown after this question is answered. expect: knowledge chunk ids (or id prefixes ending in *) that retrieval must return in both languages (tests/ask/suggestions.test.ts). The nightly eval (bun scripts/ask-eval.ts suggestions) asks every question against the real model; an optional answer.any lists strings the real answer must contain, with live values as {{facts.<path>}} placeholders, never literals. Never name a client company here (C3).
